mines.mine_notes: 100% owned via wholly-owned subsidiaries PT Meares Soputan Mining (MSM) and PT Tambang Tondano Nusajaya (TTN). Located ~35 km northeast of Manado, North Sulawesi; two Contracts of Work covering 39,817 Ha (North Minahasa and Bitung City districts), valid until 2041. Multiple open pits (Araren, Toka, Marawuwung, Kopra); processing plant capacity 4 Mtpa (upgrade to 6 Mtpa planned 2026). 2026 targets: production +15% vs 2025; opening of underground mine at Marawuwung; expected significant production boost from 2028. FY2025 cash cost not disclosed in located documents (null); Mandiri forecast ex-royalty cash cost US$1,324/oz for 2025F.
mines.processing: Flotation + CIL (4 Mtpa, upgrading to 6 Mtpa)
